displayName: Wide tables on their own page
description: Renders a table marked [.wide-page] on a page of its own orientation or size, then returns the document to normal. Landscape by default; set page-size=A3 for a larger sheet, or page-layout=portrait to keep the orientation and change only the size. A marked table inside a [.multi-column] region is left alone — the column layout wins, because changing page size under a column box draws text off the sheet.
sampleContent: A table marked as wide is moved onto a landscape page of its own, and the prose after it resumes on a normal portrait page.
